recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional core FHIR source work is needed for FHIR-47344 unless a future work-group decision changes websocket endpoint semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-47344 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested clearer Subscription.endpoint definition, short display, and comment text so websocket endpoint behavior is not described as client-supplied in the same way as rest-hook endpoints.
initial_application: The change was already applied by ac3fd3079e5d96596e6a54930833012879584176, "FHIR-47344 - Subscription.endpoint element description clarifications", and later included in merged PR HL7/fhir#3967. That commit changed the active Subscription StructureDefinition source from the older endpoint wording to the approved channel-specific URL wording.
additional_context: Subscription is active in source/fhir.ini and the current Subscription.endpoint source says URL requirements are channel-specific, with rest-hook using client-supplied http/https and websocket using server-supplied ws/wss. FHIR-I minutes record the 2025-03-31 block vote including FHIR-47344 at 17-0-0. A later Zulip implementers thread on websocket endpoints identified the old text as erroneous and pointed back to FHIR-47344 as the pending correction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current combined branch already contains the applied source commit and the active Subscription.endpoint definition matches the Jira resolution.
